$comment: Vetted MCP servers. `license` is the server code's license (must be in the allowlist in skills/community.json) or `service` for a hosted endpoint governed by vendor terms (docs/08 §7). Verify package names and URLs against upstream before enabling; pin versions.

serena.purpose: LSP-backed symbol navigation and editing (find_symbol, references, replace symbol body); read one function instead of a file
serena.install: uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent; serena project index  (see docs/11)
serena.risk: ~25 tool schemas per request: enable for build/test-writer agents only

code-review-graph.purpose: Self-updating tree-sitter code graph: blast radius, dependents, tests affected, semantic search; no LLM calls

local.note: MCP entry is generated by `code-review-graph install --platform <client>`; do not hand-write the command

code-review-graph.install: uv tool install code-review-graph; then run the install step inside the project  (see docs/11)

safety.executes: local Python server; optional save/commit hooks

code-review-graph.risk: ~30 tool schemas per request: scope per agent. Injects rules into instruction files: review the diff

context7.purpose: Up-to-date library documentation and code examples by version
context7.license_note: server code (upstash/context7) is MIT; the hosted endpoint is a service
context7.risk: Sends the library name and query; no repository content

github.purpose: Issues, pull requests, code search, actions on GitHub
github.license_note: github/github-mcp-server is MIT; the remote endpoint is a service under GitHub terms
github.risk: Token scope decides blast radius; use fine-grained PAT with read scopes unless writes are required

playwright.purpose: Drive a browser: E2E checks, form testing, scraping public pages

safety.outbound_network: any site the agent navigates to

playwright.risk: Pages are untrusted content (prompt injection). Read-only agents only; pin the version

postgres-readonly.purpose: Inspect schema and run read queries on a development database
postgres-readonly.license_note: modelcontextprotocol reference server; check the current package location (servers vs servers-archived) before use
postgres-readonly.risk: Query results enter the prompt; never point at production; restricted-lane only in enterprise

sentry.purpose: Fetch error events and stack traces while debugging
sentry.license_note: getsentry/sentry-mcp code is Apache-2.0; the hosted endpoint is a service under Sentry terms
sentry.risk: Event payloads may contain user data; scrub in Sentry first

atlassian.purpose: Jira issues and Confluence pages as task context
atlassian.license_note: hosted by Atlassian under its terms; no server code to license
atlassian.risk: Ticket text is untrusted content; read-only agents

filesystem.purpose: File access outside the working tree

safety.executes: npx package with the rights of your user

filesystem.risk: Agents already have file tools inside the repo; a broad root is a remote shell
